legacy_value_raw: Unmodified old extracted attribute string, potentially erroneous; kept separate from normalized candidate value and exact snapshot citation.evidence_text.
no_match_meaning: no matching record in this bounded and admitted view; never zero, false, or global absence

query_schema.matching: AND of all supplied selectors; unknown fields are errors; no inference or aliases

optional.condition_raw: exact original condition label or null for unrecorded condition
optional.event_type: exact event string or null for absent field
optional.variant: exact version string or null for unrecorded version

response_namespaces.accepted_facts: accepted-independent only after the complete independent review gate
response_namespaces.snapshot_readings: source_preview only; exact source citation and candidate interpretation

legacy_executors_not_imported.limitation: Extracts only the first numeric substring; ranges and attached scopes are unavailable.
Indexes head/relation/tail sets; event, variant, condition, source and review records are not preserved.

scope_limits: Exact structured record matching only; no natural-language interpretation or alias expansion.
Omitted event/variant/condition selectors retain separate matching records; no scalar collapse.
A null optional selector matches an unrecorded field, not an unconditional or universal fact.
No match means no matching admitted record in this bounded packet, not real-world absence or zero.
Snapshot readings retain AI-prepared interpretations and are not independent accepted facts.
Hash/locator/review-form checks do not establish factual truth or authenticate a human identity.
This fixed 12-record pilot is not a representative corpus or independent QA evaluation.
source_binding: whole packet and workflow audit, fact record hash, source file hash, JSON pointer and Unicode offsets
value_encoding: decimal strings preserve original precision; ranges retain two endpoints; unknown values/units are null
